title: Once Human Makes the Move to Consoles as a Free-to-Play Title
text:
Once Human, a free-to-play survival game, is making its way to consoles, offering a massive open-world experience without the need for a subscription. The game will launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on August 25, 2026, with full cross-progression and cross-play features.
The latest title coming to the PlayStation platform is Once Human , a totally free game that offers a huge survival sandbox to play in with base building, dedicated PvP areas, a bevy of quests to complete, and a mystery to unravel.
This game has been one of the best free-to-play games available for quite some time, offering surreal visuals and a massive and striking open-world. Over the years, Once Human has been tweaked and updated with brand-new content, patches, and bug fixes, and now it is ready to make the move to consoles.
Once Human's PS5 and Xbox Series X/S release is scheduled for later this year, and will launch completely for free, much like it did on PC back in 2024 and mobile in 2025. You won't need a PS Plus subscription (or Xbox Game Pass for that matter) to play it, as it is a free-to-play title and thus not reliant on a service to be played online.
Once Human does feature some premium packs and in-game purchases that cost real money, although these aren't necessary to play or even enjoy the game. Once Human is set to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on August 25, 2026. It will feature full cross-progression, so those who've already started playing it on PC or mobile can transfer their accounts, and vice versa.
There will also be cross-play, meaning anyone thinking of introducing friends on a different platform can still play alongside them. The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions will come with all previously released content and new updates, so newcomers don't have to worry about missing out. Once Human currently has a Mostly Positive rating on Steam, with 79% of its 85,000+ reviews skewing positive.
That's a strong rating that is more or less in line with its score of 71 on Metacritic. Once Human is a live service title and, as a result, comes with the expected baggage associated with those types of games.
However, for those interested in a completely free and truly massive open-world experience that's playable with friends on PlayStation without the need for PS Plus, Once Human could be the perfect title
